environment.description: Same FastAPI service on ECS Fargate. Vault Agent sidecar injects LDAP bind credentials via ephemeral tmpfs-mounted file, with Vault dynamic secret engine configured for OpenLDAP backend (lease TTL 60s, max TTL 60s). The dynamic secret engine generates unique bind DN per lease from a credential template pool. Each rotated credential is scoped via LDAP ACI to permit ONLY 'search' operations with a pre-compiled filter template constraint (ACI filter-match rule: userattr="department" matches literal string values from an enumerated allowlist maintained in the directory's cn=config). The LDAP ACI denies any search filter containing parentheses in the department attribute value position beyond the single outer grouping. Additionally, the Vault lease metadata includes a request-correlation-id that the LDAP server's access log plugin cross-references, and stale correlation IDs (>60s) trigger immediate connection termination via the directory server's connection-handler plugin.

config.secrets_engine: Vault OpenLDAP dynamic secrets, lease_ttl=60s, max_ttl=60s
config.credential_scope: Dynamic bind DN with ACI: targetfilter=(department=<literal_enum_value>) AND deny filter containing unescaped special chars in department position
config.connection_handler: Custom directory server plugin validates lease-correlation-id freshness, terminates connections with expired correlation (>60s window)
config.vault_sidecar: Vault Agent with auto-auth, template rendering to /secrets/ldap-creds (tmpfs), renewal at 45s
config.network: mTLS between service and LDAP via Consul Connect sidecar proxy
